name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered

Optimal.Notes: A 40 Hz refresh with a 30 fps cap gives smooth pacing; GPU clock boosted to 1400 MHz helps maintain frame times in open-world areas. Adjust Lumen GI to Off if frame rate drops in cities.

profiles.Summary: Oblivion Remastered is a demanding Unreal Engine 5-based title that significantly exceeds the Steam Deck's GPU class; expect 30 fps to be the realistic ceiling at low-to-medium settings with FSR upscaling. The game is Steam Deck Verified and runs under Proton, but its high PC minimum requirements mean careful tuning is essential for a stable experience.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum requirements (RX 5700 / GTX 1070 Ti minimum GPU, far above Deck class) and the Steam Deck hardware profile. On your first run, check frame rate in an outdoor area of Cyrodiil and in a city — if you see consistent dips below 25 fps even on MaxBattery, try lowering View Distance and disabling Lumen GI entirely.

MaxBattery.Notes: Rendering at sub-native resolution with Deck FSR gives the GPU the most headroom; TDP cap at 9 W prioritises battery. Drop View Distance and Foliage further if frame rate dips below 28 in dense areas.

InGameSettings.Name: Render Scale
InGameSettings.Value: 50 (use in-game TSR/FSR if available, else rely on Deck FSR)

KnownIssues: High system requirements (minimum GPU is RX 5700 / GTX 1070 Ti) make the Steam Deck GPU a significant bottleneck, limiting achievable frame rates
Unreal Engine 5 Lumen and Nanite features are very GPU-heavy and should be disabled or minimised on Deck
16 GB shared RAM may cause memory pressure in large open-world areas, potentially causing stutters
No specific Deck player reports available yet; settings are estimated from hardware capability and PC requirements

MaxPerformance.Notes: Full TDP unlocked for maximum throughput; even so, 60 fps is not realistic — 30 fps cap prevents frame pacing issues. Expect significant dips in large cities; reduce Lumen and View Distance if needed.

Optimal.Notes: A locked 30 fps with FSR from 1024x640 gives a clean image while keeping GPU stress in check; bumping textures and shadows to Medium over the MaxBattery profile adds noticeable visual improvement. Drop View Distance to Low if the Imperial City causes sustained dips.

profiles.Summary: Oblivion Remastered is a demanding Unreal Engine 5 title with PC minimum specs well above the Steam Deck's GPU class, meaning low settings and FSR upscaling are essential to reach a playable frame rate. With careful tuning the Deck can hold a stable 30 fps, but heavy outdoor areas and cities will stress the hardware significantly.
profiles.BasisNote: No Steam Deck or Linux player reports were available at the time of writing; all profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended requirements and the Deck's known GPU class (roughly GTX 1050 Ti). On your first run, check frame rate in an outdoor area near the Imperial City — if it drops below 25 fps consistently, fall back to the MaxBattery profile or lower View Distance further.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render at 960x600 with FSR upscaling to 800p to keep the GPU load manageable; TDP cap at 8 W and a fixed 1000 MHz GPU clock prevent thermal spikes and extend battery life. Expect dips in dense outdoor areas even at these settings.

KnownIssues: Heavy outdoor areas and cities (e.g. the Imperial City) can cause significant frame drops below 30 fps even at low settings
Unreal Engine 5 Lumen global illumination is very GPU-intensive and should be disabled or set to minimum for Deck play
Loading times can be long due to the large open world and the Deck's storage bandwidth
No dedicated Steam Deck / Linux player reports yet — settings are estimated from PC requirements and hardware class

MaxPerformance.Notes: Setting the refresh rate to 40 Hz and capping at 40 fps gives the smoothest high-end experience the Deck can realistically sustain; uncapping TDP lets the APU boost freely but expect heavy throttling in the busiest areas. Do not attempt native 1280x800 without FSR — the GPU cannot sustain 40 fps at full resolution in this engine.
